```{r}
# clean the table. drop too fast trials and only keep exp221 and exp111
RT_MIN_MS <- 500
df_trials <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(
    trial_kind %in% c("exp_221", "exp_111"),
    is_practice == FALSE,
    is_catch == FALSE,
    rt >= RT_MIN_MS
  )

df_items <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subj_id, triad_id, chosen_index,
    stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "stim_path"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_index = case_when(
      position == "stim_left"   ~ 0L,
      position == "stim_middle" ~ 1L,
      position == "stim_right"  ~ 2L
    ),
    choice = as.integer(pos_index == chosen_index),
    is_chosen = pos_index == chosen_index,
    nv = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "stim_nv(\\d+)_")[, 2]),
    ang = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "ang(\\d+)_")[, 2]),
    sm = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "curv(\\d+)_rot")[, 2])
  )

alt_data_diff <- df_items %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  mutate(
    sm_dev  = abs(sm - mean(sm)),
    nv_dev  = abs(nv - mean(nv)),
    ang_dev = abs(ang - mean(ang))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    trial_id = paste0(subj_id, "_", triad_id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sm_dev_s  = if (max(sm_dev, na.rm = TRUE)  == 0) rep(0, n()) else sm_dev  / max(sm_dev, na.rm = TRUE),
    nv_dev_s  = if (max(nv_dev, na.rm = TRUE)  == 0) rep(0, n()) else nv_dev  / max(nv_dev, na.rm = TRUE),
    ang_dev_s = if (max(ang_dev, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) rep(0, n()) else ang_dev / max(ang_dev, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    subj_id, triad_id, trial_id, pos_index, choice,
    sm_dev, nv_dev, ang_dev,
    sm_dev_s, nv_dev_s, ang_dev_s
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    subj_id   = as.character(subj_id),
    trial_id  = as.character(trial_id),
    pos_index = factor(pos_index, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    choice    = as.logical(choice)
  ) %>%
  arrange(subj_id, trial_id, pos_index)
```



# Fit the actual pilot model
```{r}
mlogit_data <- mlogit.data(
  data = alt_data_diff,
  shape = "long",
  choice = "choice",
  chid.var = "trial_id",
  alt.var = "pos_index",
  id.var = "subj_id"
)

model_m <- gmnl(
  choice ~ sm_dev_s + nv_dev_s + ang_dev_s | 0 | 0 | 0,
  data = mlogit_data,
  model = "mixl",
  ranp = c(
    sm_dev_s = "n",
    nv_dev_s = "n",
    ang_dev_s = "n"
  ),
  panel = TRUE
)

summary(model_m)
```

# Extract pilot estimates for simulation
```{r}
coef_all <- coef(model_m)
coef_all
```

```{r}
get_param <- function(x, possible_names) {
  hit <- intersect(possible_names, names(x))
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(x[hit[1]])
}

# Means of random coefficients
mu_sm  <- get_param(coef_all, c("sm_dev_s"))
mu_nv  <- get_param(coef_all, c("nv_dev_s"))
mu_ang <- get_param(coef_all, c("ang_dev_s"))

# SDs of random coefficients
sd_sm <- get_param(coef_all, c("sd.sm_dev_s", "sigma.sm_dev_s"))
sd_nv <- get_param(coef_all, c("sd.nv_dev_s", "sigma.nv_dev_s"))
sd_ang <- get_param(coef_all, c("sd.ang_dev_s", "sigma.ang_dev_s"))

pilot_pars <- tibble(
  parameter = c("mu_sm", "mu_nv", "mu_ang", "sd_sm", "sd_nv", "sd_ang"),
  estimate  = c(mu_sm, mu_nv, mu_ang, sd_sm, sd_nv, sd_ang)
)

pilot_pars
```

```{r}
design_template <- alt_data_diff %>%
  select(pos_index, sm_dev_s, nv_dev_s, ang_dev_s) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())  # temporary, not essential

template_trials <- alt_data_diff %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  mutate(template_trial = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(template_trial, pos_index, sm_dev_s, nv_dev_s, ang_dev_s) %>%
  distinct()

n_template_trials <- dplyr::n_distinct(template_trials$template_trial)
```


# Choice simulator for the mixed logit model
```{r}
sample_subject_trials <- function(trials_per_subj, n_template_trials) {
  if (trials_per_subj <= n_template_trials) {
    sample.int(n_template_trials, size = trials_per_subj, replace = FALSE)
  } else {
    sample.int(n_template_trials, size = trials_per_subj, replace = TRUE)
  }
}

softmax_probs <- function(x) {
  z <- exp(x - max(x))
  z / sum(z)
}

simulate_once_mixl <- function(
  Nsubj,
  trials_per_subj,
  mu_sm, mu_nv, mu_ang,
  sd_sm, sd_nv, sd_ang,
  template = template_trials
) {
  subj_ids <- paste0("S", seq_len(Nsubj))

  beta_subj <- tibble(
    subj_id = subj_ids,
    b_sm  = rnorm(Nsubj, mean = mu_sm,  sd = sd_sm),
    b_nv  = rnorm(Nsubj, mean = mu_nv,  sd = sd_nv),
    b_ang = rnorm(Nsubj, mean = mu_ang, sd = sd_ang)
  )

  subj_trial_map <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(Nsubj), function(i) {
    tibble(
      subj_id = subj_ids[i],
      sim_triad = seq_len(trials_per_subj),
      template_trial = sample_subject_trials(trials_per_subj, n_template_trials)
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_id = paste0(subj_id, "_", sim_triad)
    )

  dsim <- subj_trial_map %>%
    left_join(template, by = "template_trial") %>%
    left_join(beta_subj, by = "subj_id") %>%
    mutate(
      utility = b_sm * sm_dev_s + b_nv * nv_dev_s + b_ang * ang_dev_s
    ) %>%
    group_by(subj_id, trial_id) %>%
    mutate(
      prob = softmax_probs(utility),
      chosen_alt = sample(pos_index, size = 1, prob = prob),
      choice = as.integer(pos_index == chosen_alt)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
      trial_id = as.character(trial_id),
      pos_index = factor(pos_index, levels = c(0, 1, 2))
    ) %>%
    select(subj_id, trial_id, pos_index, choice, sm_dev_s, nv_dev_s, ang_dev_s)

  dsim
}
```


# Fit function for each simulated dataset
```{r}
fit_mixl <- function(dsim) {
  dsim_mlogit <- mlogit.data(
    data = dsim,
    shape = "long",
    choice = "choice",
    chid.var = "trial_id",
    alt.var = "pos_index",
    id.var = "subj_id"
  )

  tryCatch(
    gmnl(
      choice ~ sm_dev_s + nv_dev_s + ang_dev_s | 0 | 0 | 0,
      data = dsim_mlogit,
      model = "mixl",
      ranp = c(
        sm_dev_s = "n",
        nv_dev_s = "n",
        ang_dev_s = "n"
      ),
      panel = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}
```

# Extract p-values from the fitted mixed logit model
```{r}
extract_pvals_mixl <- function(model_fit) {
  if (is.null(model_fit)) {
    return(c(
      p_sm = NA_real_,
      p_nv = NA_real_,
      p_ang = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  cf <- summary(model_fit)$CoefTable
  rn <- rownames(cf)

  get_p <- function(term) {
    if (!term %in% rn) return(NA_real_)
    cf[term, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  }

  c(
    p_sm  = get_p("sm_dev_s"),
    p_nv  = get_p("nv_dev_s"),
    p_ang = get_p("ang_dev_s")
  )
}
```

# Main power simulation loop
```{r}
power_sim_mixl <- function(
  Nvec = c(12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40),
  trials_per_subj = 405,
  sims = 200,
  alpha = 0.05,
  mu_sm, mu_nv, mu_ang,
  sd_sm, sd_nv, sd_ang
) {
  results <- tibble()

  for (N in Nvec) {
    cat(sprintf("\nSimulating mixed logit: N = %d, trials_per_subj = %d, sims = %d\n",
                N, trials_per_subj, sims))

    sim_results <- pblapply(seq_len(sims), function(s) {
      dsim <- simulate_once_mixl(
        Nsubj = N,
        trials_per_subj = trials_per_subj,
        mu_sm = mu_sm,
        mu_nv = mu_nv,
        mu_ang = mu_ang,
        sd_sm = sd_sm,
        sd_nv = sd_nv,
        sd_ang = sd_ang
      )

      mfit <- fit_mixl(dsim)
      extract_pvals_mixl(mfit)
    })

    sim_mat <- do.call(rbind, sim_results)

    power_sm  <- mean(sim_mat[, "p_sm"]  < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
    power_nv  <- mean(sim_mat[, "p_nv"]  < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
    power_ang <- mean(sim_mat[, "p_ang"] < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)

    results <- bind_rows(
      results,
      tibble(
        N = N,
        trials_per_subj = trials_per_subj,
        power_sm  = power_sm,
        power_nv  = power_nv,
        power_ang = power_ang
      )
    )

    cat(sprintf("  -> power: sm = %.3f, nv = %.3f, ang = %.3f\n",
                power_sm, power_nv, power_ang))
  }

  results
}
```


# Run the power analysis
```{r}
# For your reduced design: 405 trials per participant
set.seed(123)

Ngrid <- c(12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40)
sims  <- 200   # increase to 300-500 for final estimate
trials_per_subj <- 405

power_mixl_405 <- power_sim_mixl(
  Nvec = Ngrid,
  trials_per_subj = trials_per_subj,
  sims = sims,
  alpha = 0.05,
  mu_sm = mu_sm,
  mu_nv = mu_nv,
  mu_ang = mu_ang,
  sd_sm = sd_sm,
  sd_nv = sd_nv,
  sd_ang = sd_ang
)

power_mixl_405
```

```{r}
# Smallest N reaching 80% power
target <- 0.80

minN_mixl_405 <- power_mixl_405 %>%
  summarise(
    min_N_for_80_sm  = if (any(power_sm  >= target)) min(N[power_sm  >= target]) else NA_integer_,
    min_N_for_80_nv  = if (any(power_nv  >= target)) min(N[power_nv  >= target]) else NA_integer_,
    min_N_for_80_ang = if (any(power_ang >= target)) min(N[power_ang >= target]) else NA_integer_
  )

minN_mixl_405
```


```{r}
power_mixl_405 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(power_sm, power_nv, power_ang),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "power"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = N, y = power, color = predictor)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulation-Based Power Analysis for Mixed Logit Model",
    x = "Sample size (number of subjects)",
    y = "Estimated power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
